### WebIDE v0.4.0

- 新增了 GitHub Actions 自动构建，推送代码或打 tag 即可自动打包双架构 APK

- 修复了创建项目时入口文件名被改写为 index.html 的问题

- 修复了入口文件不是 index.html 的项目无法预览的问题

- 新增了主界面终端入口，普通终端会话不再强制跟随项目路径

- 修复了终端环境网络异常导致 apk 无法安装软件包的问题

- 优化了构建速度，原生库只编译需要的架构

- 更新了版本号

# en

- Added GitHub Actions automated builds; pushing code or a tag now packages APKs for both architectures automatically.

- Fixed an issue where the entry file name was overwritten to index.html when creating a project.

- Fixed an issue where projects whose entry file was not index.html could not be previewed.

- Added a terminal entry on the main screen; regular terminal sessions no longer force-follow the project path.

- Fixed a network issue in the terminal environment that prevented apk from installing packages.

- Improved build speed by compiling native libraries only for the required architecture.

- Updated version number.


**Full Changelog**: `https://github.com/h465855hgg/WebIDE/compare/0.3.9...0.4.0`
